$comment: MSI GPU (address 0x68), worked out by hand from OpenRGB d4798c12 MSIGPUController.cpp / RGBController_MSIGPU.cpp, not by running the plugin. Each write is [register, value] (SMBus Write Byte Data to 0x68). init_reads is the RGBController constructor's read order: SetupZones() (R1 G1 B1 R2 G2 B2 R3 G3 B3), GetDeviceMode() (0x22), GetSpeed() (0x38), brightness (0x36). init_writes is DeviceUpdateMode() for Direct: brightness 5*20, then mode STATIC 0x13. frame_123456 is DeviceUpdateLEDs() for #123456: 0x26 = 0, then SetRGB1. shutdown_restore writes the startup_registers back, mode last; shutdown_unreadable is the static shutdownColor #000000 used when a startup read failed.
